title: fix(studio): 流程页头信息条按顺序逐个让位，不再整排缩成单字 (#36745)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-warren"} -->
_Requested by **Warren** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8?thread=cmsg_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8CSSa72mrtYoeegnZzNftqp)_

Fixes #36745

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 在 Studio 自动化里打开一个流程，标题旁那排「触发 · 状态 · 运行身份 · 版本 · 出错时」在右侧属性面板打开、位置变窄时，不再整排挤成一个字一个省略号；放不下的从后往前整项收起，鼠标悬停这一排能看到收起的内容。
- 来自你 11-23 的 Studio 评审（第 r07 项），属于界面体验缺陷修复。
- 出错的话最多是这一排显示的项目多一个或少一个，不影响流程本身和任何数据，可直接撤回。
- 无。

## What changes

`FlowMetaPills`' header variant laid its items on a one-row grid whose columns could all shrink to zero (objectui#13135), so a short meta slot (about 80 px with the property panel open) shrank every item at once, to one character each.

- `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/previews/FlowPreview.tsx`
  - New `FlowMetaHeaderRow`: every item is laid out whole (`shrink-0`, `whitespace-nowrap`), each after its `·` separator, in a row that takes the slot's width and clips. After each render and on resize (`ResizeObserver` on the row) it measures each item's width and the row's, keeps the first N whole items, and makes the rest `invisible` + `aria-hidden` (still laid out, so still measured: they come back when the row widens). The row's `title` names each hidden item's whole `Label: value`, one per line, in row order; with nothing hidden there is no `title`.
  - New `fitFlowMetaItems(widths, available, floor = 2)`: as many whole items from the front as fit (half-pixel slack). Fewer than the floor (Trigger + Status) ⇒ 0: the row shows nothing.
  - Drop order is the row order from the end: On error, then version, then Run as. Trigger and Status are the floor.
  - The header `Pill` no longer truncates (`min-w-0 truncate` → `whitespace-nowrap`), and the per-pill cut measurement (`useCutText`, objectui#13135) is removed: nothing in the header can be cut any more. A shown pill keeps its own hover text (Status: the run status's reason; Trigger: the object's API name).
  - The designer's info bar (`variant="bar"`) is unchanged.
- `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/StudioDesignSurface.tsx`: the `auto-flow-meta` wrapper goes `inline-flex` → `flex` (plus a comment line), so the row reads the meta slot's whole width rather than its own content width.
- Tests: `FlowPreview.headerMetaTruncate-13135.test.tsx` is deleted (it pinned the `truncate` class this card replaces); `FlowPreview.headerMetaGiveWay-36745.test.tsx` is added.
- Changeset: `@object-ui/app-shell` patch. `fitFlowMetaItems` is a module export, not on the package index.

Reading taken on the card: "Keep Status and Trigger whole … hide the slot when not even one item fits". The card names On error, version and Run as as the items that drop, so Trigger + Status are read as the floor: when those two do not both fit whole, the row hides. (The other reading, dropping Status and then Trigger one by one, would drop an item the card says stays.)

## Tests

- `FlowPreview.headerMetaGiveWay-36745.test.tsx`, 11 tests, widths stubbed per element (each item 120/110/80/30/60 px):
  - 400 px: all five shown, no row title;
  - 320 px: version and On error hidden, title = `v3` + `On error: …`;
  - 240 px: Run as hidden too, Trigger and Status stay;
  - 200 px (below the floor): every item hidden and `aria-hidden`, title names all five;
  - re-render wider: items come back; no header item carries `truncate`;
  - CONTROLS: a shown Status keeps its run-status hover text; the `bar` variant has no give-way row;
  - `fitFlowMetaItems` at the boundaries (399/400, 229/230) and fractional widths.
- Ablation (`fitFlowMetaItems` returning every item regardless of width): 6 of 11 red; restored, `git diff HEAD` empty.
- The test file imports `@objectstack/lint` at module top (`check:test-source-alias`: the source under test reaches its dynamic import; the load is paid at collection, not inside a clocked case).
- Also run: `AutomationsPillar.tabs-12454.test.tsx`, `StudioItemHeader.statusPlace-12524.test.tsx` (they read `auto-flow-meta`): 20/20 with the new file. `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell type-check`: exit 0.

## Acceptance notes

Browser run on the showcase app (Studio › Automations › "Notify on Task Completed", zh-CN, 1440×900 unless named; its meta has four items, no On error). Shots are attached on the project thread (GitHub image upload is browser-only). Readings are the row's own `data-shown`, item widths and `title`:

| Frame | Slot width | Items shown | Row hover text |
|---|---|---|---|
| Property panel open (the r07 case) | 81 px | none (Trigger 123 + Status 82 = 205 px do not fit) | 触发 / 状态 / 运行身份 / v1, one per line |
| Panel closed | 441 px | all four, whole | none |
| Panel closed, 1300 px viewport | 301 px | Trigger, Status, Run as | `v1` |
| Panel closed, 1220 px viewport | 221 px | Trigger, Status | 运行身份: 用户 / v1 |
| Panel closed, 1150 px viewport | 151 px | none | all four |

No frame shows a cut or single-character item. Native `title` tooltips do not render headless, so the hover text is evidenced by the attribute.

## Verification

- Two-minute check: in Studio › Automations, open a flow with the property panel closed (wide header: every item shows whole), then open the property panel: the row keeps Trigger and Status whole or hides, never single characters; hover the row to read what was dropped.
